name: Capability Permission Broker
description: Central permission broker that all capability requests must go through. Broker decides based on stored policy, produces receipts for grants and denials, and enforces time-limited grants with automatic revocation.
purpose: Centralize all permission decisions through a single capability broker that enforces policy, produces audit receipts, and automatically revokes time-limited grants.
acceptanceCriteria: All permission requests route through the central broker
Broker makes decisions based on stored policy (allow, deny, prompt)
Every grant and denial produces a structured receipt
Grants have configurable time-to-live with automatic revocation
Broker exposes an audit trail of all requests and decisions
Policy can be updated at runtime without restart
